# Paths to source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_6/training_8.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source DataFrames (concatenate)
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types
target_columns = [
    'average_salary', 'city_state', 'company_id', 'company_info', 'company_name',
    'company_rating', 'country_name', 'job_desc', 'job_title', 'post_date'
]

df_union = df_union[target_columns]

# Convert types according to target schema:
# average_salary: string (keep as is, NaNs remain NaN)
df_union['average_salary'] = df_union['average_salary'].astype('string')

# city_state: string
df_union['city_state'] = df_union['city_state'].astype('string')

# company_id: integer (some may be float due to NaNs, convert carefully)
# If there are NaNs, convert to Int64 (nullable integer)
df_union['company_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_union['company_id'], errors='coerce')
df_union['company_id'] = df_union['company_id'].astype('Int64')

# company_info: string (the examples show list of tuples as string, keep as string)
df_union['company_info'] = df_union['company_info'].astype('string')

# company_name: string
df_union['company_name'] = df_union['company_name'].astype('string')

# company_rating: float (nullable)
df_union['company_rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df_union['company_rating'], errors='coerce')

# country_name: string
df_union['country_name'] = df_union['country_name'].astype('string')

# job_desc: string
df_union['job_desc'] = df_union['job_desc'].astype('string')

# job_title: string
df_union['job_title'] = df_union['job_title'].astype('string')

# post_date: string
df_union['post_date'] = df_union['post_date'].astype('string')

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file without the index
df_union.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
